_comment: Brisket Trade Advisor (public League Hub trade advisor) — FAIRNESS-ONLY (owner amendment 2026-10-20; spec docs/trade/NTEAM_TRADE_ENGINE_SPEC.md §6.3). Every number here is a DECLARED PRIOR, not a fitted constant. pickProjectionLabels is owner decision OD-2 (default OFF). maxTeams is the public ceiling (also capped at the league's team count); maxLegs is a payload-safety bound, not a per-team quantity cap (OD-8). LAUNCH GATE: every route answers 503 advisor_unavailable/not_ready until ALL of: responseFloorMs is a measured positive int (or a measured per-teamCount table {"2": ms, "3": ms, "4": ms}) from the market_fairness worst-case p99, measured locally never against production; approvedFairnessVersion equals fairness_bands.receipt().version AND the bands are no longer PROVISIONAL (owner decisions OD-F1..OD-F6); approvedSourcePermissionRecord names the owner's OD-3 source-permission record: a .json file under docs/owner/ that src/trade/public_advisor_permission.py validates (exact recordType/schemaVersion/scope, named approver, approvedAt <= today <= reviewBy, every voting source approved by its own or its provider's entry) — merely existing is not enough (R2-10); analyze admission control (concurrency + caller deadline) lives in config/trade/analyze_admission.json, sizes PENDING OWNER CONFIRMATION; the package model is geom_q078_v1 with config ok. The feature flag brisket_trade_advisor stays OFF until the owner approves launch.
